results.title: Different types of customer feedback (and what to do with them)
results.content:
With negative ones, ask to discuss it further. You may be able to resolve whatever triggered the bad review. Brownie points if you go back and let whoever complained know when you’ve fixed the issues.

### Social media mentions

Customers don’t always come to you with feedback. Sometimes they share it where their friends and followers can see. Posts on X, LinkedIn, and Reddit all count. TikTok comments and YouTube replies do too.

A frustrated customer might post about a feature that’s broken. A delighted one might post a workflow they built with your product. Both are useful signals you’d never see in a survey.

Why this type of customer feedback matters [...] See if they’ll leave a review on G2, GetApp, or Capterra
 Ask for a testimonial for social proof
 See if they’d be willing to be featured as a case study on your website
 Ask if they know anyone who might want to use your product

Don’t be pushy about this. You don’t want to ruin the good impression they have of you by being annoying.

### Customer complaints

While it’s always nice to be praised, there’s value in negative feedback too. Praise usually comes from happy customers that aren’t having any problems. That’s great. On its own, it doesn’t give you much direction to improve.

An unhappy customer can highlight areas you can improve. Train your customer support team to dig in and uncover the actionable feedback behind complaints. [...] ## What is customer feedback?

Customer feedback is any information customers share about their experience with your product. It covers everything from a glowing review to a frustrated bug report. The label applies whether they wrote it, said it, or rated it.

### The two main types of customer feedback

You’ll see feedback grouped in two ways. The first split is direct vs. indirect.

 Direct (solicited) feedback: You ask customers specific questions. Examples: surveys, net promoter score (NPS), customer satisfaction (CSAT), interviews.
 Indirect (unsolicited) feedback: Customers volunteer information without you asking. Examples: product reviews, social media mentions, support tickets, app store ratings.

### The sign does not display the speeds of some or all of the oncoming traffic. (Power issue with solar/battery backup) [...] ### The sign is generating inaccurate speed readings (incorrect speeds, random speeds, or ghost speeds). (Sign installation issue)

Is something interfering with the radar signal? Does the Blue LED go solid with oncoming traffic?

Inaccurate readings can occur in certain environments. To avoid this possibility, do NOT INSTALL the radar speed sign facing any of the following:

 Large LED billboards or signage
 AC units with fans
 Large transformer
 Fan(s)

### Some LEDs do not display when the screen is showing speeds. (Sign Installation Issue)

Contact Radarsign Customer Support via email (customerservice@radarsign.com) or by calling 678-965-4814 during normal business hours.
